title: Namespaces and workloads
description: What runs in a namespace or workload: pods, CPU, memory, network, restarts and replicas, and the logs of the same selection. Pick an application to see only its services.

list.name: application
list.label: Application
list.description: Narrows the dashboard to the services of one Ikhnos application: each service in the one namespace of the one cluster the application names, so a service that exists in two namespaces is never mixed up. All applications (the default) leaves everything as it was. Cluster, Namespace and Workload still apply on top.

list.name: workload
list.label: Workload
list.description: A Deployment. Pods of other kinds of workload (DaemonSets, Jobs) are included while All is selected.

list.name: member
list.label: Members (derived)
list.description: The services of the chosen application, each as service/namespace/cluster. Empty with All applications. Not meant to be changed.

list.name: service
list.label: Service names (derived)

query.query: query_result(label_replace(vector(1) and on() (label_replace(vector(1), "application", ${application:doublequote}, "", "") and on(application) label_replace(vector(1), "application", "__all__", "", "")), "service_name", ".*", "", "") or group by (service_name) (ikhnos_application_info{application=${application:doublequote}, member=~"$member"}))

list.definition: query_result(label_replace(vector(1) and on() (label_replace(vector(1), "application", ${application:doublequote}, "", "") and on(application) label_replace(vector(1), "application", "__all__", "", "")), "service_name", ".*", "", "") or group by (service_name) (ikhnos_application_info{application=${application:doublequote}, member=~"$member"}))
list.description: The service names of the chosen application; with All applications the single value .* (anything). Not meant to be changed.

targets.expr: 60 * sum by (continuum_cluster_id, k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name) (rate({k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", k8s_deployment_name=~"$workload"} | continuum_cluster_id=~"$cluster" | label_format ikhnos_member="{{.service_name}}/{{.k8s_namespace_name}}/{{.continuum_cluster_id}}", ikhnos_scope="${member:pipe}" | ikhnos_scope="" or ikhnos_member=~"${member:pipe}" [$__interval]))
